Game Overview

Super Sky Fire is a shooter game built around pilot your aircraft in Super Sky Fire, an arcade shooter where you fend off enemy waves threatening Earth. Navigate through engaging pixel art landscapes, collecting power-ups to boost your firepower and dodge attacks. With automatic shooting and simple controls, it offers thrilling retro-style action for all ages.
